# Session 5 - results on the test maps (generated by run_experiments.py)

Noisy runs: seeds 0..19 (N = 20); sigma_xy = 0.02 m, sigma_theta = 0.02 rad. Time and length: mean ± std over SUCCESSFUL noisy runs, (n) = number of successes used. Guard: real minimum over the path segments, mean ± std over all runs (worst case). Compute: median / p95 of the per-decision time, microseconds, on this machine.

The classic system uses exactly the Sugeno avoidance: the comparison mostly concerns the goal law, and Mamdani vs Sugeno in avoidance.
